voci.proprieta: polimorfi noti di LON e forme del brevetto
voci.citazione: Three polymorphic forms of LON are known, two of which (α and β) were reported by Benetollo et al310 with an in-depth structural analysis and structure-activity relationship of the β-form. More recently, a patent by Xinmin et al321 described three forms which can be identified as the two from Benetollo’s work with a third, new form. Through powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) data, the work in these two reports can be correlated: α- and β- correspond respectively to forms I and II in the patent, with the third form being assumed as a new γphase
voci.qualitativo: α- and β- (Benetollo et al.) correspond to forms I and II of the patent; the third form is assumed as a new γ-phase
voci.note: Dato citato da altri lavori (Benetollo et al.; brevetto di Xinmin et al.), correlato dagli autori con PXRD e DSC; numeri in lettere.

This would suggest a high solubility, but with a kinetic barrier.
voci.qualitativo: similar initial dissolution rate to LON despite the higher solubility; may be impeded by the larger relative proportion of poorly soluble LON (2:1 ratio); dissolution rate increasing fastest at the end of the experiment; high solubility with a kinetic barrier
